annotation.bound_parties_text: The guideline directs the relevant departments and local governments (provincial energy, industry and IT, SASAC and market regulation authorities) to implement it according to their duties, and encourages central enterprises and industry associations.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: 各有关部门按照职责分工，加强战略谋划、统筹协调和督促检查，指导各地方和有关单位开展工作，形成合力共同推进本意见组织实施。各地方结合本地能源装备产业基础与特色优势，同步制定差异化实施方案
